name: Shaking the World: The Sixties
description: Ten years of moon rockets, miniskirts, marches, guitars and wars, when the young demanded change and the old order struggled to answer.

checkpoints.name: The new frontier
checkpoints.note: Kennedy takes office, seventeen African countries win independence in 1960, Gagarin goes into orbit, the Pill changes family life, Hitchcock's Psycho shocks cinemas and Rachel Carson's Silent Spring alarms readers. The Cuban Missile Crisis nearly leads to war.

checkpoints.name: Marching and mop-tops
checkpoints.note: Martin Luther King Jr. and Malcolm X speak for different paths in the fight for civil rights, which wins the Civil Rights Act and the Voting Rights Act. The Beatles, Dylan and the Stones transform music, and America sends more troops to Vietnam.

checkpoints.name: Summer of love
checkpoints.note: Mao launches the Cultural Revolution, Muhammad Ali refuses the draft, and Sgt. Pepper and Pet Sounds push pop into art. Hendrix burns up the stage at Monterey, Star Trek imagines a peaceful future, and Israel wins the Six-Day War.

checkpoints.name: Upheaval and the Moon
checkpoints.note: The Prague Spring is crushed, King is shot and Vietnam rages. Kubrick's 2001 looks to the stars, Apollo 11 lands on the Moon and Woodstock gathers half a million. Stonewall sparks a new gay rights movement, and Altamont marks the end of the dream.
